parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance that contains the topic you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的Topic所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the topic that you want to query
parameters.name: topic

SubscriptionDataList.description_en: The information about the online consumer groups that subscribe to the topic

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the consumer group that subscribes to the topic
GroupId.description_zh: 订阅该 Topic 的 Group ID

MessageModel.description_en:
The consumption mode. Valid values:

CLUSTERING: the clustering consumption mode

BROADCASTING: the broadcasting consumption mode

For more information about consumption modes, see [Clustering consumption and broadcasting consumption]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43163.html）
MessageModel.description_zh:
消费模式。取值说明如下：

CLUSTERING：集群订阅
BROADCASTING：广播订阅

消费模式的更多信息，请参见[集群消费和广播消费]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43163.html）

Online.description_en: Indicates whether the consumer group is online

SubString.description_en: The expression based on which consumers in the consumer group subscribe to the topic

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This parameter is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
